paper.title_en: Logarithmic corrections to massive particle trajectories for the classical soft log theorems at leading order in $G$
paper.abstract_en: We study the logarithmic corrections to the asymptotic trajectories of massive particles. These corrections enter the calculation of the soft-log sector of the radiative field at null infinity in four-dimensional gravitational scattering. We first isolate the part of the metric which enters the particle equations of motion. We show that the nonlinear source can only affect this sector through homogeneous modes on the hyperboloid, and that matching to the proposed soft tower implies that these modes vanish, except for the first mode. We show that this mode cannot affect the trajectory coefficients at leading order in G. We then invert the matter energy-momentum tensor on the particle worldlines to obtain the trajectory coefficients at leading order in $G$ and at every logarithmic order using Legendre polynomials. The first two coefficients reproduce the known results at orders $G$ and $G^2$. .

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究引力散射中软对数定理所需的渐近轨迹对数修正，涉及零无穷远附近的辐射场结构、软塔模式匹配及能动张量反演，属于广义相对论基础与引力波理论交叉方向，理论深度较高，方法具体，对新近预印本而言具有较好的点击价值。
decision.title_zh: 经典软对数定理在$G$领头阶下大质量粒子轨迹的对数修正
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究大质量粒子渐近轨迹的对数修正。这些修正进入四维引力散射中零无穷远处辐射场软对数部分的计算。我们首先分离出进入粒子运动方程的度规部分。我们表明，非线性源只能通过双曲面上的齐次模式影响该部分，并且与所提出的软塔相匹配意味着这些模式消失，除了第一个模式。我们表明，该模式在$G$领头阶不能影响轨迹系数。然后，我们对粒子世界线上的物质能量-动量张量进行反演，利用Legendre多项式得到在$G$领头阶以及每个对数阶的轨迹系数。前两个系数重现了$G$阶和$G^2$阶的已知结果。
